Intro: Tell me: do you fear magic, my friend? Do you stand in awe of its power?
Ah, but I see in those eyes a nonbeliever. To which I take offense, for I happen to be a world-renowned warlock!
Yes, indeed, you fear me now. But I am kind. So fetch me a [DISH], and I shall spare you my might.
Success: You lack a skill for spellcraft. This may be what saves you. Farewell, good warrior.
Fail: You dare slight a warlock!? Very well! Face the powers born of the beyond!
Reject: Hmhmhm… I believe you bear the arcane powers as well. May witchery be all you desire.
